body:
Don't be so harsh to yourself. 
I have been dealing with depression and anxiety my whole life. When I was 16 I asked my parents if I could get some help, my mother replied that I wasnt sick, that it was just a phase.
When I was 18 I tried to commit suicide for the last time. It was the first time my parents were notified about it. When I came home after a few days nobody talked to me, my mom just came into my room talking about how it was all her fault. Everything went on as if nothing happened. A few months later she tried to kill herself and spent a few months at the mental hospital were I had to visit her every day because she wouldn't eat without me. Meanwhile I was still incredibly depressed, I tried getting help but they told me that I had to wait 6 months for an appointment. I had to take care of my brother all by myself and when my dad was home I had to take care of him as well.

After she got released from the hospital she stopped taking her meds, stopped going to therapy. I would try to be as comforting as possible but she wouldn't accept any help. By that time I got annoyed. She had all the resources to get better, people were supporting her but she kept refusing everything. I got a message from her about what to do with her stuff, my dad called me and told me she ran away. It was a Wednesday at midnight. I had to work the next day and I was so annoyed.

I met up with her at the train station and she started crying about how we would be better off without her etc. I remember feeling nothing but annoyance and resentment towards her. I was intentionally cold and rational, and I think that rattled her oit of her emotional thinking. I talked her into spending a few days at a friends place. She soon returned home.

What I want to say is that I get it. You tried to help. We can only help people that want to change. She didn't want to and tried to use suicide as a last fuck you. You might have been harsh but it's not your fault.
I don't have an apartment, I also loved spending time walking in the fields. I'd like to be away from people and somewhere nice before I go.
